Module com.ecotwin
Package com.ecotwin.service

Class EnergyService

java.lang.Object
com.ecotwin.service.EnergyService
public class EnergyService extends Object
Monthly household energy readings: electricity used and, optionally, solar generated (US-15, US-19, US-14).

Every change is written to the household's activity history and triggers a score recalculation. Edits record the old and new values of only the fields that changed.

  • Method Details

    • recordEntry

      public EnergyEntry recordEntry(User actor, Household household, double electricityKwh, Double solarGenerationKwh, String notes)
      US-15: record the household's energy usage for the current period.
      Parameters:
      actor - the user recording the reading
      household - the household it belongs to
      electricityKwh - electricity used this month, in kWh
      solarGenerationKwh - solar generated this month in kWh, or null if the household has no solar
      notes - optional free-text notes
      Returns:
      the saved entry, dated to the current month (YYYY-MM)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either value is negative

    • updateEntry

      public EnergyEntry updateEntry(User actor, Household household, long entryId, double electricityKwh, Double solarGenerationKwh, String notes)
      US-19: update an existing energy entry.

      US-14: the history message names each value that changed with its old and new value, e.g. "changed energy usage from 410.0 kWh to 395.0 kWh and solar generation from none to 60.0 kWh". If nothing changed, it just says the entry was updated.

      Parameters:
      actor - the user making the edit
      household - the household the entry belongs to
      entryId - the entry to change
      electricityKwh - the corrected electricity use, in kWh
      solarGenerationKwh - the corrected solar generation in kWh, or null for none
      notes - optional free-text notes
      Returns:
      the updated entry
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either value is negative

    • validateEnergyValues

      private void validateEnergyValues(double electricityKwh, Double solarGenerationKwh)
      Rejects negative readings. Zero is allowed: it is a real reading, not a missing one.
      Parameters:
      electricityKwh - electricity used, in kWh
      solarGenerationKwh - solar generated in kWh, or null for none
      Throws:
